scope: Corollary 5.4 of the manuscript “Integrable metrics and effectivity with controlled boundary” (preprints/Integrable-metrics-and-effectivity-with-controlled-boundary-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 068 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 79cff3abcc899987), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Y be smooth projective of positive dimension and A0 ≥ 0 rational. Suppose B = −KY + A0 has a semipositive metric with locally integrable squared frame norms, smooth and strictly positive on a nonempty ordinary open. For every pseudoeffective rational M there is a rational ϵ > 0 such that A0 + ϵM is rationally linearly equivalent to an effective rational divisor.
